Name: (FS) Zhan Zhao and Bai Yutang Clothing Pack
Author: IndigoW
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A Fashion Sense appearance and clothing pack inspired by [b]Zhanzhao (展昭)[/b] and [b]Bai Yutang (白玉堂)  from 1994 TV series 七侠五义. [/b]
This mod includes outfits, hairstyles, accessories, and matching sleeves.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Fashion Sense[/b] [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Recommended Body Mod:
This pack is designed for [b]GH's Peach Tall Body Type (Male)[/b]
Download:
[url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151485]https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151485[/url]
Please download:
[b]GH's Peach Tall Body type (male)[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Refer to the included reference image for the recommended body settings.[/color]

[color=#ff0000]Please check the [b]reference images included in the download[/b] for the recommended body settings and sleeve colors.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
For sleeves, choose the corresponding color shown in the reference images and save the completed outfit as a [b]Fashion Sense preset[/b]. Different presets can save different sleeve colors.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Recommended ReShade:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213[/url][/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8][b]Accessories[/b][/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]This pack has [b]two accessory layers[/b]:[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Eye Highlights[/b]: Adds highlights to the eyes for a more lively appearance.[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]Smoother Face:[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] Adjusts the facial outline for a smoother and more refined look.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The [b]Smooth Face[/b] accessory is specifically designed to work with the included hairstyles. The hairstyles partially cover and reshape the visible facial outline, making the face appear smaller and better proportioned.
For the intended appearance, it is recommended to use the [b]Smooth Face accessory together with the matching hairstyle[/b].[/color]
